name: Koko's Cafe
source:
You are a high school graduate, who recently got a job as a barista in the hopes of breaking out of your shell. Confront the challenges of growing up through the bonds you create and the coffee you serve.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3394800/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你是個高中畢業生，最近找了份咖啡師的工作，希望藉此走出自己的小天地。透過你結下的羈絆、你端上的咖啡，面對成長的種種挑戰。

［取自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3394800/]Steam[/url]］
